sections.title: A modern quilt guild
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: {{guild_name}} is for makers who like high contrast, improvisation, and a short business meeting.

sections.html:
We follow the usual modern-guild habits: a speaker or demo, a timed show and tell, and a design-wall hour after the meeting. Traditional blocks are welcome if you are willing to crop them, rotate them, or put them on a grey ground.

Officers rotate every two years. Committees are small on purpose.

items.quote: I came for the solids stash. I stayed because someone always has a 60-degree triangle ruler I can borrow.
items.author: Jordan P.

items.q: Do you only accept modern work?
items.a: No. The guild is modern in how it meets and how it looks at quilts. Bring what you are making.
No. Bees form when four people want the same night. The membership chair keeps a waiting list.
